paper_title: Gated Attention for Large Language Models Non-linearity, Sparsity, and   Attention-Sink-Free
caption_used: Mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers, comparing pre-gating, post-gating, and baseline configurations. The hidden state mean before gate (blue dashed line, avg 0.71) remains near zero through approximately layer 15, then rises sharply to a peak of roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The post-gating hidden state mean (orange dotted, avg 0.05) and baseline mean (green solid, avg 0.04) both remain close to zero throughout, with the baseline showing marginally higher values than the post-gating mean in the final layers. The dramatic pre-gating increase beginning at layer 12 demonstrates that gating effectively suppresses the activation amplification observed in deeper layers.

model_annotations.Bulgarian: Тази линейна диаграма илюстрира промяната на средната абсолютна стойност на скритите състояния (Abs Mean) по моделни слоеве (Layer), като сравнява три конфигурации: преди вратата (before gate), след вратата (after gate) и базов модел (baseline). Оста X, означена като „Layer“, представлява номера на слоя и варира от 0 до 23, с етикети на интервали от 5 единици (0, 5, 10, 15, 20). Оста Y, означена като „Abs Mean“, е линейна и показва средната абсолютна стойност на скритите състояния, с диапазон от 0 до 4 и етикети на интервали от 1 единица (0, 1, 2, 3, 4). Три линии са представени: синя пунктирана линия („hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71“) започва близо до 0, остава ниска и почти постоянна до около слой 15, след което рязко нараства — достига 0.8 около слой 18, 2.6 около слой 20, и достига връх от около 2.8 при слой 23. Оранжева точкована линия („hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05“) остава почти постоянно близо до 0 през целия диапазон, с леко нарастване до около 0.08 при слой 23. Зелена сплошна линия („hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04“) също остава близо до 0, с леко по-високи стойности от оранжевата линия в по-дълбоките слоеве — около 0.05 при слой 23. Всички три линии са маркирани с текстов легенд, който включва средната стойност за целия диапазон.
model_annotations.Chinese: 该图表展示了不同配置下模型各层隐藏状态的平均绝对值，用于比较门控前、门控后与基线设置的激活模式。横轴“Layer”表示模型层数，范围从0到约23，刻度为线性，间隔为5；纵轴“Abs Mean”表示隐藏状态平均绝对值，范围从0到4，刻度为线性，间隔为1。蓝色虚线代表“hidden state mean before gate”，其值在前15层内维持在接近0的水平，从第12层起开始缓慢上升，第18层约为0.5，第20层升至约0.9，第22层达约2.6，最终在第23层达到约4.2的峰值。橙色点线代表“hidden state mean after gate”，其值在所有层中均接近0，从第0层到第23层稳定在0.01至0.06之间，平均值为0.05。绿色实线代表“hidden state mean of baseline”，其值同样接近0，在第0层至第23层间缓慢上升，从0.01增至约0.12，平均值为0.04，且在后几层略高于橙色点线。三条线均未标注误差带或置信区间，仅展示平均趋势。
model_annotations.English: The line plot titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three configurations: “hidden state mean before gate” (blue dashed line, average 0.71), “hidden state mean after gate” (orange dotted line, average 0.05), and “hidden state mean of baseline” (green solid line, average 0.04). The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to 23 with linear spacing and integer tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4 with linear spacing and tick labels at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line remains near zero through layer 15, then rises sharply—reaching approximately 0.9 at layer 18, 2.6 at layer 21, and peaking at roughly 4.3 at layer 23. In contrast, the orange dotted line stays close to zero across all layers, with values never exceeding 0.1. The green solid line also remains near zero, with a slight upward trend in the final layers, reaching approximately 0.1 at layer 23—marginally higher than the orange line in that region. No markers are used; all lines are drawn with their respective styles and colors as described in the legend.
model_annotations.German: This line chart, titled “Hidden State Mean,” plots the mean absolute values of hidden states across model layers for three configurations: “hidden state mean before gate,” “hidden state mean after gate,” and “hidden state mean of baseline.” The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 23 with tick marks at intervals of 5, indicating a linear scale representing discrete model layers. The y-axis, labeled “Abs Mean,” ranges from 0 to 4 with tick marks at intervals of 1, representing the average absolute magnitude of hidden state activations. The blue dashed line (“hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71”) begins near 0 at layer 0, remains relatively flat and close to zero through layer 15, then rises sharply starting around layer 17, reaching approximately 0.9 at layer 20 and peaking at roughly 2.8 at layer 23. The orange dotted line (“hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05”) stays near zero across all layers, with values consistently below 0.1, showing minimal variation. The green solid line (“hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04”) also remains near zero throughout, with values slightly above the orange line in the final layers (e.g., approximately 0.08 at layer 23 versus 0.05 for the orange line), but still well below 0.1.
